name: read-only SSM access does not fire COMPUTE-SESSION-TAKEOVER
note: ssm:GetCommandInvocation / ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation cannot execute code on an instance, so the standalone session-takeover primitive must NOT fire. Only the interactive/exec session actions are the capability.
rationale: ssm:GetCommandInvocation and ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation are read/describe actions; they do not run commands or open a session, so they cannot execute code under the instance role. COMPUTE-SESSION-TAKEOVER must fire only on the interactive/exec session actions, so a read-only SSM policy is a true negative.
